scripts.format: prettier --write . "!**/.test-cache/**" "!**/.pytest_cache/**" "!tmp/**" && uv --cache-dir .uv-cache run ruff format apps
scripts.format:check: prettier --check . "!**/.test-cache/**" "!**/.pytest_cache/**" "!tmp/**" && uv --cache-dir .uv-cache run ruff format --check apps
scripts.lint: pnpm -r --if-present lint && uv --cache-dir .uv-cache run ruff check apps
scripts.test: pnpm -r --if-present test && uv --cache-dir .uv-cache run pytest apps/api/tests apps/worker/tests
scripts.typecheck: pnpm -r --if-present typecheck && uv --cache-dir .uv-cache run mypy apps/api/app apps/worker/worker
